system.description:
• Effect: See the table above for unarmed damage by level.
  • Your unarmed attacks use Strength or Dexterity (your choice).
  • From 3rd level, when you use your action to attack you make a second unarmed blow (the Secondary column).
  • Your blows never have the Disadvantage of an extra attack: they are rolled normally, are not off-hand attacks, and stack with Flowing Strikes and Haste.
  • A Monk never gains Extra Attack.
  • The monk has Advantage on all overbearing and grappling attacks
  • The monk may choose whether a successful strike deals normal damage or subdual damage

activities.name: Unarmed attacks
activities.text: Your action's unarmed blows with Unarmed Strike, none with Disadvantage: the first with your Primary dice, the second (from 3rd) and third (Flurry of Blows, 5th) with the Secondary dice, the fourth (from 13th) with the Tertiary.
